name: Postomatic
author: Fred

sections.description:
Postomatic helps you generate high-quality blog posts automatically using AI technology. Simply set your preferences
like categories, keywords and tags, then let Postomatic create engaging content. Get started right away with free
credits to try out the plugin.

Postomatic allows you to quickly create multiple blog posts with just a few clicks. It suggests SEO-friendly blog titles, and automatically generates relevant keywords, categories, and tags for each post. The plugin uses advanced AI technology (ChatGPT) to create content that is engaging, relevant, and optimized for search engines.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 5.6 or higher (PHP 7.0+ recommended for optimal performance)
  • Ability to make outbound HTTP requests to external APIs
  • Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
  • JavaScript enabled
  • Sufficient server memory (minimum 128MB PHP memory limit recommended)
  • Write permissions for the WordPress uploads directory

Features

  • AI-Powered Content Creation: Uses ChatGPT to generate high-quality blog posts based on your existing content and selected preferences.
  • Free and Paid Plans: Generate up to 4 blog posts for free. After that, buy credits to continue using the free plan
    or choose from various subscription plans to suit your needs.
  • Lifetime Access with Paid Plans: Paid plans come with lifetime access to the included features and updates, as long as Postomatic remains under active development. There are no recurring fees.
  • Customizable Post Generation: Select the category, preferred keywords for the title, and any specific tags you want the post to include.
  • SEO Optimization: Automatically fills SEO fields such as tags, categories, and meta descriptions for better search engine ranking.
  • Draft/Publish Mode: Posts can be saved as drafts or published immediately, with options to schedule for future
    publishing dates. This allows you to review, edit and add images before making content live.
  • Admin Panel Control: You can manage the plugin, buy credits, upgrade plans, get support and generate posts
    directly from the WordPress admin panel or via your Postomatic account dashboard.
  • One-Time Payment Plans: Simple subscription model with one-time payments – no recurring fees. Each plan comes with
    initial free credits. Each plan comes with bonus credits when purchasing additional credits based on your active plan level.

Usage

Getting Started

  1. After installation and activation, navigate to the Postomatic menu in your WordPress admin sidebar
  2. You’ll start with free credits that allow you to generate up to 4 blog posts
  3. To generate a post:
    • Select a category for your post
    • Enter keywords you want to include in the title
    • Add any specific tags you want the post to include
    • Choose whether to save as draft or publish immediately
    • Click “Generate Post”
  4. The AI will create a complete blog post with:
    • SEO-optimized title
    • Well-structured content with headings
    • Meta description
    • Featured image suggestions
    • Relevant tags and categories

Managing Credits and Plans

  1. To check your remaining credits, visit the Postomatic dashboard
  2. When your free credits are used up, you can:
    • Purchase additional credits to continue using the free plan
    • Upgrade to a paid plan for more features and bonus credits
  3. All plans are one-time payments with no recurring fees
  4. Each paid plan includes access to features and updates

Best Practices

  • Review and edit generated content before publishing
  • Add your own images to enhance the posts
  • Customize the content to match your brand voice
  • Use specific keywords to get more targeted content
  • Schedule posts for consistent publishing

External Service Notice

This plugin relies on an external service to function:

Service Name: Postomatic Content Generator by Buildomatics
Service URL: https://buildomatics.com/pages/postomatic/documentation
Terms of Service: https://buildomatics.com/pages/postomatic/agreement
Privacy Policy: https://buildomatics.com/pages/postomatic/privacy

The plugin connects to Postomatic’s API when you generate content, purchase credits, activate plans, or request support. Only essential data (Such as your WordPress site URL, initialization token, admin email, and site name) is transmitted during these operations and only when initiated by you.

The plugin will not function without this connection. By using the plugin, you acknowledge and accept these external connections.

Legal Information

  • Plugin Modification Disclaimer: You are free to modify Postomatic under the terms of the GPL license. However, we cannot provide support or guarantee compatibility for modified versions of the plugin.
  • Hosting and Server Responsibility: Users are responsible for ensuring their hosting environment is secure, up-to-date, and compatible with Postomatic. We are not responsible for any site issues resulting from misconfiguration or outdated environments.
  • AI Content Disclaimer: The content generated by Postomatic is produced using AI models trained on publicly available data. We do not guarantee that the generated content is original or free from third-party copyright claims. Users are solely responsible for reviewing and editing all generated content before publishing.
  • External API Usage: This plugin connects to the external Postomatic API (https://buildomatics.com/v1) to perform tasks such as post generation, subscription management, and credit tracking. Only the necessary data is transmitted and only when you initiate actions that require it.
  • Privacy and Data Protection: We collect and process only the information necessary to operate the plugin and connect with your account. For details, please see our full Privacy Policy at: https://postomatic.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress dashboard, click on ‘Plugins’ > ‘Add New’, then search for ‘Postomatic’ and click ‘Install Now’.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to the Postomatic menu in your WordPress admin sidebar
  4. Follow the setup instructions to connect your site to the Postomatic API
  5. Start generating content with your free credits

Note: This plugin requires an external connection to the Postomatic API to function properly. Your site will need to be able to make outbound HTTP requests.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without an external service?

No. Postomatic requires a connection to the Postomatic API to generate content, manage plans, and perform key functions. This API connection is required and is clearly explained above.

What are the payment options for Postomatic?

Postomatic offers a free tier with up to 4 blog posts. After that, you can either purchase credits to continue using the free plan or upgrade to one of our paid plans. All paid plans are one-time payments with no recurring fees and include lifetime access to features and updates while Postomatic remains under active development.

How does post generation work?

Postomatic uses AI technology (specifically ChatGPT) to generate blog posts based on your preferences. You can specify categories, keywords for the title, and tags you want the post to include. The generated content is SEO-optimized with appropriate meta descriptions.

Can I review posts before they go live?

Yes. You can choose to save generated posts as drafts, which allows you to review, edit, and add images before publishing. You can also schedule posts for future publishing dates.

What information is shared with the Postomatic API?

Only essential data like your WordPress site URL and initialization token is transmitted to the API, and only when you initiate actions like generating content, purchasing credits, or requesting support.

Is the generated content unique and free from copyright issues?

The content is generated using AI models trained on publicly available data. While the content is typically unique, we cannot guarantee it is free from third-party copyright claims. Users are responsible for reviewing and editing all generated content before publishing.

How do I get support for Postomatic?

Support is available through the WordPress admin panel or via your Postomatic account dashboard.
